english.note: Use this when “gain” means make progress or improve, especially in ability or performance, not when it means gain possession.
Use this when someone improves in ability, performance, studies, or skill.

examples.english: With more practice, you gain ground in English more quickly.
examples.traditional: 你多啲練習，英文就會進步得快啲。
examples.jyutping: nei5 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6 jing1 man4 zau6 wui5 zeon3 bou6 dak1 faai3 di1

examples.english: If you keep practising, your English will improve quickly.
examples.traditional: 你繼續練習，英文就會進步得好快。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gai3 zuk6 lin6 zaap6 jing1 man4 zau6 wui5 zeon3 bou6 dak1 hou2 faai3
